title: HTTPie: printing request headers

spec.text: With --print=H (or -v), HTTPie prints the request exactly as it is sent: the request line, then every header. Users can set any header on the command line, e.g. `http example.org Host:api.local X-Token:abc`; if no Host header was given, show the one derived from the URL.

context: HTTPRequest wraps a requests.PreparedRequest (self._orig). self._orig.headers is a requests.structures.CaseInsensitiveDict holding the default headers plus the user's headers. At send time, a Host header is added from the URL only when the request does not already carry one. urlsplit is urllib's; netloc may include user:password@.
